principle: R0 resectability is modeled as a dominant technical bottleneck with clinically plausible interactions, not as a simple sum of all residual disease sites.
clinical_notes: Generic liver capsule, paracolic, pelvic peritoneal, omental, or focal diaphragmatic surface disease should not by itself drive non-R0 classification.
Small stable nodes <=10 mm without suspicious wording should contribute zero risk.
Bowel/stomach raw status is down-weighted; post relation grade and exact evidence wording are preferred.
Explicit change is a weak field for many critical sites, so objective PRE/POST size ratios are used when available.
The score is dominated by the highest technical difficulty domain, then modified by a second difficult domain, multi-domain interactions, and objective response.
